mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, title, content, type, category, course_id, tags, attachment_url, status, visibility, is_top, is_resolved) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{category}, #{courseId}, #{tags}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{status}, #{visibility}, #{isTop}, #{isResolved})

SELECT p.*, u.username, u.avatar_url, c.title as course_title FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON p.course_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 'published'
AND (p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR p.user_id = #{currentUserId})

mapper.update: UPDATE post SET status = 'deleted' WHERE id = #{id}
